name: GlitchTip
summary: GlitchTip is an open-source error tracker that accepts Sentry client SDKs and also runs on your own server. Hosted plans are $15 a month for 100,000 events, $50 for 500,000 and $250 for 3 million, with a free plan of 1,000 events and a choice of US or EU hosting.

facts.text: The hosted US instance runs on DigitalOcean in New York and the EU instance on DigitalOcean in Frankfurt, with no replication between them.
GlitchTip says its controls follow SOC 2 and ISO 27001 but that it has not been audited or certified against either.
Event data is purged after 90 days by default, and a Business Associate Agreement is available on the Large plan on request.
The command line tool creates and finalizes releases, records deploys, and uploads source maps for readable JavaScript stack traces.
Events beyond the plan limit can be billed on demand at $0.17 per 1,000 for the first million over.

plans.name: Hobby and trial
plans.notes: Up to 1,000 events a month, 30-day retention

plans.name: Small
plans.notes: Up to 100,000 events a month, 90-day retention, unlimited team members and projects

plans.name: Medium
plans.notes: Up to 500,000 events a month, priority email and live chat support

plans.name: Large
plans.notes: Up to 3,000,000 events a month, BAA available on request

hiddenCosts: Annual prices are discounted but not published, so annual billing is arranged through support.
HIPAA-compliant US hosting is an add-on for Large plans.
